correctness.rationale: For arbitrary A=UK in C², scalar unitary conjugation gives U in SU(2). Splitting into a symmetric Takagi part S and skew part cJ yields tr(A²)=2-4c² and SS*=a²I. Every s=|<Ax,x>| in [0,a] occurs, and for fixed s the constrained y realizes exactly [|rs-t sqrt(1-s²)|,rs+t sqrt(1-s²)]. Maximization gives R+=1 for r<=a, else ar+bt; minimization gives R-=max(0,bt-ar). Connectedness fills all intermediate radii, common-phase covariance fills angular directions. Boundary cases a=0,b=0,r=0,r=1 included. The packaged checker check.py passed 12,978 deterministic tests; no infinite conclusion is inferred from finite tests.
